meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

howto.what_en: After configuring with this skill, the NanoClaw agent group will use your specified local Ollama model to respond instead of the Anthropic API; requests are redirected via environment variables, and api.anthropic.com can be blocked to control costs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to run an agent locally, reduce API costs, or try open-weight models. Requires Ollama to be running with a model already pulled.
